source_description: Spec for a customer-facing RAG assistant. Ingestion pipeline scrapes a configurable product page, cleans and chunks the content, embeds it into Chroma. A LangGraph agent answers end-user questions over FastAPI. Packaging includes Dockerfiles, docker-compose, and a full Helm chart with dev/prod values. Cross-cutting: hexagonal architecture (SOLID), test-first for logic with smoke/contract tests for I/O, Google-style docstrings throughout.

commands: uv run helm lint deploy/helm/support-bot --values deploy/helm/support-bot/values-dev.yaml --set secret.openaiApiKey=sk-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
uv run ruff check src tests
uv run interrogate src/support_bot/domain src/support_bot/application src/support_bot/composition
